question: What is the title and number of the chapter emerging from the moon island?
premises: The text is described as emerged from the moon island
The chapter is named supreme adamantine-making
It is identified as the fifteenth chapter
inference: The verse gives the colophon identifying the fifteenth chapter as Supreme Adamantine-Making
plain_english: In that which emerged from the Moon Island, this is the fifteenth chapter, named Supreme Adamantine-Making.
